reviews.review:
I only played for a little bit (I made it to the first airlock on episode 1 and the first airlock on the weekly challenge) and I'd probably give the game in between a thumbs up and thumbs down.

Feels like a soulless left for dead clone inside a futuristic looking spaceship or space lobby or something.

No Sprint, No Melee, No satisfaction from trying to explore, can't choose which character you want to play even in "single player", AI's are constantly calling out things way in advance but no marker or highlight is given so you'll have no idea where to look and just spin in circles trying to figure out what they keep calling out, you'll constantly be given a way-point to go recharge your weapon while walking around so it makes it so you almost just want to exclusively use your pistol to get that annoying popup to go away (just highlighting it should be enough), if you find an extra med-pack on the floor AIs don't seem to want to use med-packs even when one of their health is at 50% and everyone else is full health with a med-pack equipped, weapon feedback is terrible, combat isn't satisfying and just feels like waiting around shooting things with a stick you found laying on the ground waiting until you can progress, and I worry how much game-play even exists in this since there's only 5 episodes for the campaign mode (but yes there are 4 modes total (Campaign, pvp, horde/defense, weekly challenges) but I wonder if most people actually care about the pvp mode or how long a horde mode can keep your attention with combat this unsatisfying).

I played with 3 AIs and you can basically just run past everything until special mobs come out. Except you'll probably get lost because everything kind of looks kind of samey and it's hard to figure out the direction to go.

I'd only play this if you've exhausted other left 4 dead type games and you've got a full group of friends to play with.

Name dropping L4D2 but failing to recapture any of what was good about that game is not a good look.

Announcing too early and releasing too early killed any hope this game had.

Now it has no user base, people are voting with their feet.

A disappointing flop.

Feels awful to play! Weapons feel like pew pew without any kind of impact, enemies are either fodder, bullet sponges, or just a l4d copy. Online experience is confusing at best, unplayable at worst. 

Visuals are also confusing, when you get into the game, the first thing you see is a god awful model with nothing but death in their eyes. "The flasher" just applies a low contrast high brightness and YELLOW filter. The weapons visuals are just non-existant. Enemies look bland and never gib, their heads just disappears on headshot.

The fact that it exists is weird to me, no developer in their right mind would say "that game feels good enough, let's release it"

Just don't buy it, if this game "feels better to play on 1.0 than in E.A.", I can't imagine what it felt like in E.A.

I understand that the team working on this game is small, but there are incredible games made by small teams.

This game is close to being the complete package and a great Left 4 Dead follow up. It's just got a little too much jank to make it that. 

Things I would improve personally:

- Guns and associated sound effects really need beefing up, it feels like I'm shooting paintball guns with no impact. 
- The idea behind the Isolde and the setting around it is not fleshed out. I would love some comic book style intros or even some text exposition dumps before/during the episodes so I now more about the characters and what they're actually fighting towards, and make the stakes feel higher. 
- The 4 characters should have unique abilities instead of pulse on all of them. maybe even just Borderlands style class ideas to make them more individual and to add some more strategy. 
-The game is a bit on the short side at 4 hours. Hopefully episode 5 gets fleshed out to 3-4 episodes and the addition of exposition will make it a better time to cost prospect.

Having said that, If you want to blow up some aliens and play a Left 4 Dead clone? You'll get enjoyment out of this one, and it seems Stray Bombay are intending on fleshing the game out based on the updates they've done in early access. Can see it getting bigger and better from here. Also the lighting and reflections in the reactor episode were really awesome.

Played just the first map as of 12/08/23 only real complaint was the lack of sound effects like gun reloading footsteps from you and the aliens. There are few other little issues but this is feeling like what back 4 blood should have been.

good game to play with friends! lacks some weight, for instance the regular enemies don't really make much sound and even the heavier weapons like the rocket launcher feel a little iffy and "laggy". if they can fix these issues, which are mostly sound-related, it will be a great game. if you're looking for a L4D-like shooter to play with friends, you can't go wrong with this one. looking forward to future updates!
